sources.title: Do joint mobilizations assist in the recovery of lateral elbow tendinopathy? A systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.notes: gives LLM validated effect sizes for how manual therapy and joint glides at the elbow restore pain-free grip and range of motion.

sources.title: Functional Range of Motion Assessment in Patients with Elbow Pathology
sources.notes: The functional range of motion for the elbow is more than what many people would think showing importance of restoring full range of motion for ADL and sport.

sources.title: Effectiveness of conservative treatment in the management of post-traumatic elbow stiffness: A systematic review
sources.notes: Provides evidence for the effectiveness of conservative treatments, including joint mobilization and PNF stretching, in improving range of motion and reducing pain in patients with post-traumatic elbow stiffness.
